trigger: Reach the shore at the Sparks Marina (ch01_lake_edge).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The marina is a flat, glaring mirror. Thirty people with buckets in the heat. Somebody's set up a fire to boil.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: Hey. Pearce, right? Stead hangar guy. Fill up and move along. We're doing one trip a family.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Cal Lusk is a county deputy. He's in a uniform jacket over pajama pants. He hasn't been to work since Monday.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: I did. Somebody has to. Yesterday two guys fought over a Home Depot bucket. One went in.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: Water's warm and green and ten feet deep off the dock. He came out. Next one might not.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You fill a second jug behind a parked boat. Wraith watches Lusk the whole time, like a lookout.

nodes.speaker: amb_deputy_lusk
nodes.text: ...I saw that. Your dog's a better liar than you are. Go home.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You fill the jugs. Marina water: dirty, but it boils. Fifteen minutes at a rolling boil.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: BOIL water at home on the stove (WATER STATION). Clean water doesn't spoil. Dirty water makes you sick.
